paper_title: Upper Limit on the QCD Axion Mass from Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
notes: Paper constrains QCD axion mass from isolated neutron star cooling. Main result is m_a < 16 meV (KSVZ, 95% CL). For axion-nucleon-only models they quote |g_ann| < 1.3e-9 and |g_app| < 1.5e-9 at 95% CL. These are single bounds, not a coupling-vs-mass curve (mass is the constrained quantity here, set by f_a). The y-axis of the main exclusion plot (Fig. 3) is tan(beta) vs m_a, not a coupling. Could arguably be AxionMass, but the explicit numeric coupling limits are on g_ann/g_app. No tabulated (mass, coupling) curve is provided to extract as data points, hence data_points empty. Note both neutron and proton couplings are constrained.
